tweets.text:
Confidence in Vibe Coding Rules Aku.

Core principles: 
- Always have RULES. titik. 
- Granular, step-by-step approach 
- Spec-driven development 
- Minimal implementation first  

Development flow: 
- One feature → test → proven → refactor 
- Comment the WHY, not the what 
- Commit each working thought 
- Not working? Stash it back 
- Readable > clever code 
- Meaningful error logging 
- Review every change 
- REMOVE DEADCODE  

Server work: 
- Local bash files first 
- Think idempotency for automation 
- Everything as declaration files
